title: Complete Guide: Teide Sunset Tour in a Jeep Wrangler
description: Everything you need to know about the Teide sunset tour in a Jeep Wrangler. Route, schedule, what to bring, prices and tips for the best experience in Tenerife.
content:
The Teide Sunset Tour in a Jeep Wrangler is one of the most breathtaking experiences you can have in Tenerife. Picture yourself driving your own Jeep Wrangler through volcanic roads while the sun sets over the Atlantic, painting the sky in colours you'll never forget.

What is the Teide Sunset Tour?

Unlike typical bus tours where you're just another passenger, here you drive. Soul Jeep Experience hands you the keys to a Jeep Wrangler and provides a guided 120 km route through Teide National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

The journey lasts 3 to 4 hours, departing in the afternoon from Costa Adeje. You climb winding mountain roads, cross volcanic landscapes that look like another planet, and arrive at viewpoints over 2,000 metres high just in time for sunset.

What makes this sunset special?

Mount Teide isn't just Spain's highest peak (3,718 m) — it offers a unique phenomenon: the shadow of Teide. As the sun sets, the volcano's shadow stretches across the sea of clouds and neighbouring islands, creating a visual spectacle only visible from here.

The altitude and lack of light pollution make sunset colours extraordinarily vivid: oranges, reds, purples and golds that shift minute by minute.

Typical itinerary

  • 17:00 — Departure from C.C. Aquamall, Costa Adeje. Briefing and Jeep handover.
  • 17:30 — Ascent through mountain roads with volcanic scenery.
  • 18:30 — Arrival at the viewpoint. Time for photos and watching the sunset.
  • 19:30 — Return to Costa Adeje under the first stars.

What's included in the price?

The tour includes Jeep Wrangler rental for 3 hours, a full tank of fuel, comprehensive insurance, and a professional route guide. No hidden costs or supplements.

Prices vary by group size:

  • 1-2 people: €220 per Jeep
  • 3 people: €240 per Jeep
  • 4 people: €260 per Jeep

Tips to make the most of it

  • Bring warm clothing: at 2,000 metres the temperature can drop 15°C compared to the coast.
  • Charge your camera: sunset colours are incredible and change every minute.
  • Book in advance: spots are limited, especially during high season.
  • Arrive 15 minutes early: for the briefing and to familiarise yourself with the Jeep.

Who is this tour for?

It's perfect for couples seeking a romantic experience, adventurous families (children welcome), and groups of friends looking for something different. The only requirement is being at least 21 years old with 2 years of driving experience.

Book your Teide Sunset Tour

Don't let your Tenerife trip pass without this experience. The Teide Sunset Tour is the island's top-rated activity with 5 stars on Google. Book directly or message us on WhatsApp for the best price.
